text:
Nothing needs to be settled first. This only adds an entry to your Claude Code config and doesn't touch Tentmaker.

```sh
claude mcp add tentmaker -- tentmaker mcp
```

Then confirm it registered:

```sh
claude mcp list
```

- **Scope:** by default this registers the server only for the current project directory. If you want it available in every project, add `--scope user`:
  ```sh
  claude mcp add --scope user tentmaker -- tentmaker mcp
  ```
- **Permissions:** the read tools (`status`, `pool`, `doctor`) work as your normal user. The tools that change the device (budget, pause, repo add and so on) return an error unless the MCP server runs as root. I would leave it as is and run those changes through the CLI with `sudo`, for example `sudo tentmaker pause --for 2h`. If you do want the write tools over MCP, tell me and I'll set up a root-run registration, but that gives the agent root-level control of the device, so I'd want your explicit yes first.
